image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade baby bib lying flat on a white textured surface (likely a blanket). The bib features a diagonal color-block design: the left side is bright pink fabric with large white and smaller light green polka dots, while the right side is white fabric with faint vertical pinstripes. The entire perimeter is trimmed with gathered, light blue ruffled lace or ribbon. A yellow ribbon loop is visible at the top center, serving as the neck closure.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The polka dots maintain relatively consistent size across the curved surface, showing minimal perspective foreshortening which might be expected on a draped 3D object, though this is subtle.

Verify if the yellow ribbon at the top has a logical physical structure or if it is just a blob of color. Check if the diagonal seam between the pink and white fabrics looks like a sewn joint or a digital blend.
